report.explanation: Only one trace shows a gateway->order ERROR span (~1989ms). All service metrics show error_rate 0.001, p95 70ms, zero dependency timeouts and zero db pool waiters; gateway/payment logs are OK. Order shows retained heap after GC with WARN logs, but no chronological retention series exists, so a leak is not established. Current facts are insufficient to bound a root cause; handoff with missing evidence.
